study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Oliveira-Saraiva and Ferreira, Frontiers in Psychiatry, 2023
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative model detects abnormal functional connectivity in psychiatric disorders

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative model based on an autoencoder.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Here, we propose a normative model based on autoencoders.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Resting-state functional connectivity matrix derived from Pearson correlations of FBN BOLD time series.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Pearson's correlation coefficients between the extracted blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) time series of all FBNs were calculated, and a correlation matrix was generated for each subject.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: No explanatory variables reported; autoencoder received no sex/age covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Fourthly, we started with a simple autoencoder that received no information about sex/age.
